cohort: 1,225 HIV-1 infected mothers and their uninfected infants
finding: This study found that the median durations of any breastfeeding and exclusive breastfeeding were 40.6 and 20.9 weeks, respectively, and several sociodemographic factors were associated with breastfeeding practices.
mod_finding: Mothers who underwent C-section were found to stop any breastfeeding earlier.
country: Burkina Faso, South Africa, Uganda and Zambia
